summary: Phase 4 FazerCards generic mapping validated end-to-end. Backend: 34/34 live tests pass (adapted /tmp/tp4.py from /app/tests/test_phase4_live.py: switched the 'missing' assertion from 180-uc to 90-uc because 180-uc is already composite-mapped in this env). Verified: direct mappings (60/325/660/1800/3850 UC, prime 1m, prime plus 1m, evo packs), composition creation/modification (120=60x2, 720=660+60) with fulfillable=False (hors scope multi-order), refusal cases (composite on prime → 409 'direct uniquement', wrong sum → 409 'Composition invalide', non-UC component → 409 'pas une offre UC', unknown offer → 409 'n'existe pas'), unconfirmed mapping (evo-fragments-mythique → mythic_emblem_pack) → mapping_status=unconfirmed, fulfillable=false. GET /admin/fazercards/mappings returns all 4 types (uc/prime/prime_plus/evo) with mapping_status + fulfillable + supplier_cost_usd. GET /admin/fazercards/coverage lists specials with kind + used_by (First Purchase, Weekly Deal 1&2, Fragments matériaux, Emblème mythique, Fragments mythique) and unused (Elite Pass LV1-50/100, Elite Pass Plus LV1-100 → 'Disponible chez FazerCards — non activée sur MGS'). Public GET /api/products strips fazercards_mapping + price_usd and exposes purchasable flag. Activation guard: PUT /api/admin/products/{id} of a requires_mapping product without mapping → 409 'Mapping fournisseur'. Order creation on that product → 'unavailable'. Regression: legacy 90-uc order without mapping still creates successfully; preflight on that paid order returns 409 'Mapping fournisseur manquant'. Frontend: /pack-evolutif renders 6 special offers (Fragments matériaux, Premier achat, Emblème mythique, Fragments mythique, Weekly Deal Pack 1, Weekly Deal Pack 2) under 'Packs spéciaux' with Ar prices, no UC/Prime duplication; eligibility dialog (evo-pubg-input+evo-check-button) verified with pubg_id 5123456789 → 'Éligible !'. Admin /admin/fournisseur renders fzr-group-uc/prime/prime_plus/evo with '✓ configuré' / '✓ composition' / '⚠ Mapping fournisseur manquant' badges + supplier cost per product; fzr-configure-90-uc opens fzr-config-dialog with fzr-mode-direct/fzr-mode-composite radios, fzr-category-select, fzr-offer-select, fzr-confirmed-toggle, fzr-mapping-save; switching to composite exposes fzr-comp-qty-0/fzr-comp-offer-0/fzr-comp-remove-0/fzr-comp-add/fzr-comp-total-uc/fzr-comp-total-usd/fzr-comp-check (dialog closed without saving). fzr-coverage-load populates fzr-coverage-list with the expected used/unused badges. Admin /admin/commandes: paid mono-article order on 90 UC (no mapping) MGS-B08C3B shows fzr-missing-MGS-B08C3B '⚠ Mapping fournisseur manquant' and NO fzr-send-* button; paid mono-article order on 60 UC (direct confirmed) MGS-59C6D5 shows fzr-send-MGS-59C6D5 'Envoyer au fournisseur'. NEVER clicked fzr-send/fzr-preflight-confirm; NEVER called POST /admin/orders/{id}/fazercards/fulfill; test seed orders cancelled afterwards. Existing mappings preserved (adapter test used /tmp/tp4.py to avoid touching source).
